For in the seven days of the festival
that were laid down according to intellect
in which the nations too have a hold;
through the action of the mitzvos
as is brought in the holy Zohar
"The weapons of war in the right hand
allude to the instruments of action:
eyes, mouth and body, as mentioned above,
in which there is a hold
for the nations too, to some degree,
by means of weapons of war.
all the middos are bound in the heart
with which there is no connection at all
to the nations of the world.
And so one bull is offered,
And this is the aspect of
"the lip of truth shall be established forever"
the Name Havayah, blessed be He,
for the nations have a hold
only in the Kinuyim, the appellations.
Therefore there is no mitzvah in deed
which is the binding of the Torah
into the heart of the souls of Yisrael;
and this is the matter of the three bonds:
the Holy One, blessed be He, the Torah and Yisrael
And in the name of the holy Rebbe of Peshischa,
may the memory of the righteous and holy be for a blessing
for the life of the World to Come:
that Shemini Atzeres is the Ushpiza of Shlomo;
correspond to Yesod and Malchus of Malchus,
and so the holy Zohar sometimes counts
David and Shlomo in place of Yosef and David.
And David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
was always a man of wars,
with a heart like the heart of a lion,
and this was because he had
to be "a mighty one who conquers his inclination"
as it says, "and my heart is hollow within me"
for he slew it through fasting;
from which it follows that he had
constant war with the evil inclination.
And with this strength he prevailed in war
always over the nations of the world,
who were of the opposite aspect,
And this is what we are occupied with
throughout the seven days of the festival.
But Shlomo HaMelech, peace be upon him,
for there had already been bound
wisdom and holiness in his heart,
and he had no need for war.
And of him it is said,
"so He gives to His beloved in sleep"
he was bound to Hashem, may He be blessed.
וְלָכֵן הָיָה כָּל הִתְגַּלּוּת הַחָכְמָה שֶׁלּוֹ
Therefore all the revelation of his wisdom came
as it says, "In Givon Hashem appeared
to Shlomo in a dream of the night"
because all the thoughts of his heart
were always bound to Hashem, may He be blessed.
And so was the aspect of
Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
of whom it is said, "And he dreamt...
and behold, Hashem stood over him"
And this too is the matter
of the aspect of Shemini Atzeres.
with David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
that he never saw a good dream,
because he was of the aspect of the known "Tzedek,"
which is "the law of the Kingdom,"
and he took the judgments upon himself,
as it says, "Your rod and Your staff,
and as our Sages of blessed memory said
as they, of blessed memory, said
"A bad dream — its sadness suffices for it";
